supersedes: WP4-LIFT-NI-v1, invalidated before freeze because ambient generic rank does not imply rank on J=0, K=0
purpose: Prove and qualify a precise transfer obstruction for shell-regular, physically admissible meromorphic Liouville integrability of the qualified WP2-MULTIQ-v1 KS atlas, including the spatial-to-planar variational subquotient needed by that transfer.
goal: Conditional on the pinned published planar Morales-Ramis and monodromy result, prove that the translation-reduced spatial positive-mass Newtonian three-body Hamiltonian is not completely meromorphically integrable near the embedded nonzero-angular-momentum parabolic Lagrange phase curve, and prove that any shell-regular complete physically admissible integrable family on the qualified KS atlas would descend to a forbidden complete physical family. A PASS rules out such a family on every atlas domain containing that regular neighborhood.
evidence_boundary: A passing result is a conditional theorem extension and transfer proof. It independently checks exact KS quotient identities, two-spinor product reduction, chart compatibility inherited from frozen WP2 evidence, fixed-energy Sundman conservation and Poisson identities, shell-relative functional-rank descent, collision-free restriction, reflection splitting, fixed-nonzero-angular-momentum planar reduction, and the planar normal variational subquotient. It consumes, but does not rederive, the published 4x4 planar normal variational equation or its non-virtually-Abelian differential Galois or monodromy group. It excludes ambient-only rank that disappears on J=0 or K=0, gauge-dependent or chart-dependent upstairs functions, explicit clock-dependent functions, non-meromorphic and non-Liouville notions, nonzero-Xi magnetic dynamics, a general SO(3) quotient, triple-collision regularization, and an independent new derivation of the published planar obstruction.

model.physical_phase_space: The regular collision-free part U of the 12-dimensional total-linear-momentum-zero translation quotient of the spatial Newtonian three-body phase space, complexified on the standard algebraic distance cover used by Morales-Ramis analyses.
model.physical_hamiltonian: H on U with three strictly positive finite masses and positive gravitational constant.
model.extended_physical_space: U_ext=U x T*R with coordinates (z,t,p_t), canonical form omega_U+d p_t wedge d t, dimension 14.
model.upstairs_chart: Each WP2-MULTIQ-v1 chart is T*(R4 x R4 x R), dimension 18, with two commuting cotangent S1 actions and momentum map J=(Xi1,Xi2).
model.regular_domain: J^-1(0) with both selected spinors nonzero and the third pair distance nonzero. The T2 action is free there and its quotient is U_ext.
model.regularized_hamiltonian: K=g*(H+p_t) after quotient, where g=r12*r23*r31 is positive on the real collision-free domain and nonzero on the complex regular domain under consideration.
model.physical_shell: S is J=0 and K=0. On the regular domain K=0 is equivalent to p_t=-H.
model.atlas: Three quotient-induced charts with canonical transitions on collision-free overlaps, exactly as frozen by WP2-MULTIQ-v1.
model.variational_reduction_chain: Along the nonzero-angular-momentum planar Lagrange phase curve: spatial translation-reduced VE dimension 12; reflection-fixed planar VE dimension 8; tangent-to-L_z=k quotient by the rotational generator dimension 6; normal quotient by the phase-flow and energy directions dimension 4. The pinned published NVE is the final differential subquotient, up to meromorphic gauge equivalence.

admissible_integrability.name: shell-regular physically admissible meromorphic Liouville family
admissible_integrability.definition: On a connected T2-invariant regular open neighborhood N in an 18-dimensional lifted chart containing the physical lifted parabolic Lagrange phase curve, a family (K,p_t,Xi1,Xi2,F1,...,F5) of nine meromorphic first integrals is admissible when all nine are pairwise Poisson commuting; the nine ambient covectors are linearly independent at a relative dense-open subset of S intersect N; every Fi commutes with p_t, Xi1, and Xi2; and the restrictions of every Fi to J=0 agree under every frozen WP2 chart transition.
consequences_of_definition: Commutation with p_t makes every Fi independent of the clock coordinate t.
Commutation with Xi1 and Xi2 makes the J=0 restriction T2-invariant and therefore projectable.
Chart compatibility makes each projected function single-valued on the physical atlas.
Shell-relative ambient rank excludes integrability whose only fifth horizontal direction is multiplied by Xi or H+p_t and disappears on the physical shell.
Dependence on p_t or Xi away from their frozen levels remains allowed when the shell-relative rank condition is met.
not_admissible: A function that changes across two representatives of one physical chart overlap.
A function with explicit physical-clock dependence.
A family with ambient generic rank nine whose rank is below nine everywhere on S.
A collection that is conserved but lacks pairwise involution or shell-relative functional independence.

theorem_obligations.T1_single_ks_reduction: For q != 0, prove the Hopf/KS radius identity, identify the vertical kernel with the S1 generator, prove Xi is its cotangent momentum map, and prove the projected canonical Poisson brackets on Xi=0.
theorem_obligations.T2_product_and_extended_reduction: Prove that the product of two regular zero-Xi quotients, with the untouched (t,p_t) pair, has dimensions 18 -> 16 -> 14 and is locally the qualified physical extended phase space.
theorem_obligations.T3_chart_gluing: Use the verified WP2 projection-transition identity to prove that projectable functions descend consistently and that quotient Poisson brackets are chart-independent.
theorem_obligations.T4_sundman_transfer: For every clock-independent projectable F, prove {F,K}=g*{F,H}+(H+p_t)*{F,g} on J=0, hence conservation equivalence on K=0 wherever g != 0.
theorem_obligations.T5_involution_transfer: Prove that pairwise upstairs involution implies pairwise involution of the shell restrictions f_i(z)=F_i(z,-H(z),0), including possible p_t dependence.
theorem_obligations.T6_shell_rank_transfer: In momentum-map adapted local coordinates, prove pointwise that rank nine of (K,p_t,Xi1,Xi2,F1,...,F5) at S implies rank six of (H,f1,...,f5), and therefore transfer relative dense-open shell rank. Explicitly reject ambient-only rank as insufficient.
theorem_obligations.T7_collision_domain: Prove that a global meromorphic family on any atlas extension containing the regular domain restricts to the regular collision-free domain; binary-collision extension cannot evade an obstruction on that open set. No triple-collision regularization premise is used.
theorem_obligations.T8_spatial_variational_subquotient: Along the planar parabolic Lagrange solution embedded in the spatial translation quotient, prove exact reflection invariance of in-plane and vertical variational subspaces; identify the fixed-nonzero-L_z rotational reduction as a differential quotient of the planar block; and identify the published 4x4 planar NVE as the subsequent normal differential quotient.
theorem_obligations.T9_galois_quotient: Prove that virtual Abelianity of the full spatial variational differential Galois group would force virtual Abelianity of every differential subquotient; combine its contrapositive with the pinned non-virtually-Abelian planar normal quotient.
theorem_obligations.T10_global_implication: Prove only that a global shell-regular admissible family would restrict to the locally obstructed regular neighborhood. Do not interpret the local theorem as an orbit classification or a statement about arbitrary regularity classes.

independent_validation.production: Exact integer and rational matrix identities and polynomial-structure checks implemented without SymPy in src/python/wp4_lift_ni_v2.
independent_validation.reference: A source-disjoint SymPy module that differentiates the defining KS, transfer, rotational-momentum, and Newtonian expressions directly and does not import the production implementation.
required_controls: A deliberately wrong KS momentum factor fails the canonical Poisson identity.
A nonzero-Xi probe exposes the magnetic Poisson residual and is not classified as physical zero-level reduction.
A clock-dependent probe fails the p_t commutation gate.
An exact commuting family with rank supplied only by I1 away from S is rejected by the shell-rank gate.
Removing one genuine shell-horizontal rank direction fails the rank-transfer control.

decision_policy.PASS: Every theorem obligation, shell-relative rank premise, prerequisite, source, exact-identity, independent-reference, negative-control, proof-coverage, and boundary gate passes under a frozen implementation.
decision_policy.FAIL: Any missing implication, source mismatch, exact-identity failure, reference disagreement, negative-control escape, shell-rank gap, chart gap, spatial-subquotient gap, or boundary violation fails v2 and requires a new campaign version.
decision_policy.AUTHORIZED_CLAIM: Conditional on the pinned published planar normal-variational nonintegrability result, the translation-reduced spatial positive-mass Newtonian three-body Hamiltonian is not completely integrable by meromorphic first integrals near the embedded nonzero-angular-momentum parabolic Lagrange phase curve. Consequently, the qualified WP2-MULTIQ-v1 atlas admits no complete shell-regular physically admissible meromorphic Liouville family on any domain containing that regular neighborhood.
decision_policy.PROHIBITED_SHORT_CLAIM: The three-body problem has no integrals.
decision_policy.PROHIBITED_RAW_UPSTAIRS_CLAIM: The unreduced KS Hamiltonian admits no complete family without the shell-regularity, gauge, chart, and clock conditions.

invalidation: Any change to the theorem statement, shell-relative admissibility definition, model boundary, prerequisite identity, source payload, proof obligation, negative control, decision rule, or frozen implementation invalidates v2. A failed frozen execution remains FAIL.
